params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: With the language on French or English, a chassis number that is too short in the chassis lookup dialog shows the placeholder "createCarDNA fr" / "createCarDNA eng" instead of a message.

From the test round of 12 October 2026 (Portal mail:14, item 8).

In the dialog "Create a vehicle with chassis number", a chassis number that is too short (for example three characters) is rejected by validation. In Dutch the dealer reads "Deze waarde bevat te weinig characters"; in French the red line under the field reads `createCarDNA fr`, in English `createCarDNA eng`.

Cause: `resources/lang/fr/carDna.php` and `resources/lang/en/carDna.php` still carry placeholder values for `min`, `max` and `no_more_credits` (French also keeps `resting_tokens` right, English does not). `CarVweRequest::messages()` points the `min` and `max` rules at these keys. The sibling file `carVWE.php` has the same placeholder for `no_more_credits` in both languages, which the header button shows as a tooltip when the credits are gone.

Related but separate: #650 is about the same kind of placeholder in `damage.php`.
params.title: French and English chassis lookup shows 'createCarDNA fr' instead of the validation message
